components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-approval { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.2rem 1.75rem; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; background: var(--brass); color: var(--ink); font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-approval-heading { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-approval-heading div { display: grid; } .ds-approval-heading strong { font-size: 1rem; } .ds-approval-heading small { color: #332a16; font-size: 0.78rem; } .ds-approval-mark { position: relative; display: block; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; flex: none; border: 2px solid var(--ink); } .ds-approval-mark::before { position: absolute; top: 0.24rem; left: 0.61rem; width: 2px; height: 0.58rem; background: var(--ink); content: ""; } .ds-approval-mark::after { position: absolute; bottom: 0.2rem; left: 0.56rem; width: 0.12rem; height: 0.12rem; background: var(--ink); content: ""; } .ds-approval p { margin: 0.75rem 0; font-size: 0.78rem; } .ds-approval code { display: block; font: 0.75rem/1.55 ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, monospace; } .ds-approval-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 0.6rem; } .ds-approval button { min-height: 2.65rem; padding: 0.6rem 0.95rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink); font: 700 1rem "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-approval-deny { background: var(--ink); color: var(--chalk) !important; } .ds-approval-allow { background: transparent; } .ds-approval-allow:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--chalk); } .ds-approval button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--brass), 0 0 0 5px var(--ink); }

components.css: .ds-ledger-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7rem minmax(0, 1fr); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft); background: #15130f; color: var(--paper); font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-ledger-meta { display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 0.3rem; padding: 1.15rem 1rem 1.15rem 1.75rem; border-right: 1px solid var(--line-soft); color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-ledger-meta strong { color: var(--paper); font-size: 0.72rem; } .ds-ledger-content { min-width: 0; padding: 1.1rem 1.75rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-ledger-title { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.85rem; } .ds-ledger-title strong { color: var(--chalk); font-size: 0.88rem; } .ds-action-marker { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 0.9rem; height: 0.9rem; color: var(--brass); } .ds-action-marker::before { position: absolute; top: 0.4rem; left: 0.05rem; width: 0.7rem; height: 2px; background: currentColor; content: ""; } .ds-action-marker::after { position: absolute; top: 0.22rem; right: 0.05rem; width: 0.35rem; height: 0.35rem; border-top: 2px solid currentColor; border-right: 2px solid currentColor; content: ""; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-ledger-content ul { display: grid; gap: 0.3rem; margin: 0.75rem 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; color: var(--muted); font: 0.78rem/1.55 ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, monospace; }

narrative.overview:
Froe feels like work inspected on a machinist's marking bench: matte charcoal fields hold the work, fine scored rules establish order, chalk-warm text remains legible for long runs, and brass identifies the proof-bearing moments. The interface is dense, explicit, and deliberately unsoftened. Its visual hierarchy comes from sequence, contrast, and ruled structure rather than decorative containers.

The Evidence Ledger is the world's signature expression. User tasks, model statements, Actions, results, approval boundaries, and outcomes all occupy one ordered record with a fixed sequence gutter. Authority is never hidden behind generic chat chrome: decisions appear as high-contrast interruptions inside the same evidence stream.
keyCharacteristics: Matte charcoal surfaces separated by scored one-pixel rules.
Square controls and containers with no corner rounding.
Warm, hyperlegible sans-serif text with monospaced operational detail.
Brass reserved for proof, primary action, active status, and authority boundaries.
Dense two-column ledger rows that remain legible at the minimum desktop width.

rules.name: The Brass Proof Rule
rules.body: Brass marks authorship, evidence-bearing state, primary action, and explicit authority boundaries; no other brand accent competes with it.

rules.name: The Semantic Exception Rule
rules.body: Danger Coral is reserved for failure, invalid input, and cancellation. It never decorates neutral or successful states.

rules.name: The Contrast Ratchet Rule
rules.body: When the operating system requests more contrast, annotation and rule tones become lighter while the palette's roles remain unchanged.

rules.name: The Evidence Type Rule
rules.body: Natural-language reasoning stays in the hyperlegible sans-serif; executable or machine-shaped evidence switches to monospace.

rules.name: The Gutter Label Rule
rules.body: Ledger and rail metadata is compact, tracked, and uppercase so it reads as indexing rather than narration.

rules.name: The Visible Authority Rule
rules.body: Workspace, Session state, model, directory authority, MCP status, and Run record remain in the persistent rail throughout active work.

rules.name: The Ordered Stream Rule
rules.body: Responsive changes may tighten gutters and padding, but they do not reorder or visually detach evidence from its sequence label.

rules.name: The Scored-Not-Floating Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are separated by tone and rules, never by drop shadows, blur, or glass effects.

rules.name: The Square Instrument Rule
rules.body: Interactive and informational containers stay square; circles and pills are not part of this system's container vocabulary.

dos: Do preserve the two-column ledger row with its visible sequence-and-type gutter for every evidence event.
Do use brass to identify primary action, active status, authored task, outcome, and authority boundary.
Do keep machine-shaped values in monospace and human explanation in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next.
Do separate regions with one-pixel scored rules and reserve two-pixel rules for stronger boundaries.
Do keep Workspace and Session authority visible while a Run is active.
donts: Don't introduce rounded cards, pill buttons, circular status badges, or softened container corners.
Don't add floating shadows, gradients, glass blur, or decorative texture to resting surfaces.
Don't add a second brand accent or use Danger Coral outside failure, invalid-input, and cancellation states.
Don't turn the Evidence Ledger into chat bubbles or detach Actions, approvals, and verification from their ordered sequence.
Don't hide disabled authority-changing actions during a Run; show their unavailable state explicitly.
